sources.title: Executive bodies: Oliver Blume biography
sources.findings: Born 6 June 1968, Brunswick; TU Braunschweig degree 1994, Tongji doctorate 2001; Audi trainee 1994, VW production planning 2009, Porsche production/logistics 2013; VW CEO 1 September 2022.
sources.caution: Read Blume section, status 1 January 2026. Other executives on this page are not Blume. Do not infer exact dates for the early SEAT roles from ambiguous wording.

sources.title: 17 October 2025: CEO agreement through 2030
sources.findings: New five-year agreement starts 1 January 2026; dual CEO role ends then.
sources.caution: 2030 is the agreed future term, not a completed tenure or guaranteed future outcome.

sources.title: Michael Leiters succeeds Oliver Blume on 1 January 2026
sources.findings: Leiters appointed effective 1 January 2026; Blume hands over at year end and continues as VW Group CEO.
sources.caution: Historical announcement uses the then-current dual title. Current VW biography independently confirms Porsche tenure ended in 2025. Leiters career must not be assigned to Blume.

sources.title: 24 July 2026: interview with Volkswagen CEO Blume
sources.findings: Direct answers about restructuring, competitive pressures and supervisory approval; biographical sidebar corroborates education and career.
sources.caution: Read opening and restructuring discussion plus sidebar, not all interview sections. Statements about market conditions and plans remain attributed; publication date is not an independently established recording date.

sources.title: 30 September 2015: Oliver Blume is new CEO
sources.findings: Porsche executive chair effective 1 October 2015, succeeding Matthias Müller; production/logistics board member since early 2013.
sources.caution: September 30 is announcement, October 1 effective date. Other appointments on the page have different dates. Company praise is not independent assessment.

sources.title: 29 September 2022: Porsche IPO
sources.findings: Preferred shares began Frankfurt trading under P911 during Blume tenure.
sources.caution: Porsche AG is distinct from Porsche SE holding company. Corporate IPO is not a personal sale; 2030 electrification targets in historical release are not achieved results or confirmed current guidance.
